UNSAFE_allowDiscardLocalCacheWhenOffline.description:
If true, the local cache will be removed when the user navigates away from
the dirty form even when offline. By default, cache is only removed on back when online.
Defaults to false.

bannerErrors.description: Network or user errors to be displayed as a banner at the top of the form

bannerMessages.description: Status messages to be displayed as a banner at the top of the form

children.description: Content to be passed into the form

disableKeyboardAwareScroll.description:
@internal Do not use this prop. It is a hack and will be removed.
TODO: JOB-147156 This is a HACK for multiline inputs on iOS scrolling issue.
Disables the keyboard aware scroll view.
This is needed to fix issues with multiline inputs on iOS. DO NOT

formRef.description: ref object to access react hook form methods and state

type.name: RefObject<UseFormReturn<T> & { scrollViewRef?: RefObject<KeyboardAwareScrollViewRef>; saveButtonHeight?: number; messageBannerHeight?: number; }>

initialLoading.description: Loading when the initial form data is being fetched

initialValues.description:
The initial values of the form inputs
This should be available as soon as initialLoading is set to false

type.name: { [x: string]: any; } | ((BrowserNativeObject | NestedValue) & FieldValues) | { [x: string]: any; }

localCacheExclude.description:
Forms field names that will not be considered for caching.
Useful for omitting sensitive data.

localCacheId.description:
A string or array of strings that can be used to identify the pre-filled
data on the form. This can be used to support local caching for forms that
prefill data without inadvertently applying the cache at the wrong time.

For example this can be used to when an object is based on data from
another object (Quote being converted into a Job). This will allow
the user to retrieve data from the cache when trying to create the
same object (same Quote being converted into a Job) following an app crash.

There is still only one copy of data for each `localCacheKey`.
If a user opens the same form the data will only be loaded if the `localCacheId` matches

localCacheKey.description:
Adding a key will save a local copy of the form data that will be used to
recover values when the app is backgrounded or has crashed.

mode.description:
When the validation should happen.
Possible values are "onBlur", "onChange", "onSubmit", "onTouched", and "all".
The default value is "onTouched"

onBeforeSubmit.description: A callback function that is run before invoking onSubmit. Form submission is canceled if the promise resolves to false.

onSubmit.description:
A callback function that handles the submission of form data.
If an error occurs during submission, it should not be caught and handled silently; the error must be thrown again.
If the submission is successful and no error is thrown, the `onSubmitSuccess` callback will be called.
If an error is thrown, the `onSubmitError` callback will be called.

onSubmitError.description: A callback function that handles any error that occurs during "onSubmit"

onSubmitSuccess.description: A callback function that handles a successful form submission from "onSubmit"

reValidateMode.description:
When the validation after submission should happen.
Possible values are "onBlur", "onChange", and "onSubmit".
The default value is "onChange"

renderFooter.description: Renders a footer below the save button.

renderStickySection.description:
@deprecated use `secondaryAction` instead.
Override default save button in the sticky section of the form with another element.

type.name: (onSubmit: () => void, label: string, isSubmitting: boolean) => ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>

saveButtonLabel.description: Label to be displayed for the save button

saveButtonOffset.description:
A number that will pull down the save button when the position is sticky.
Useful when there's a footer or content below the form that is pulling
the button up.

showStickySaveButton.description:
Forces to render the sticky save button instead of the inline.
The sticky save button is default for iOS but not for Android due to
limitations. Use this prop with caution on Android.
